summary: Resolved Known Issue #1: all five direct after-line-breaking overwrites (cnb/off-key.ly NoteHead x2, cnb/test-ids.ly Beam/Tie/Slur) now register through a new chaining helper in cnb/utils.ly (cnb:compose-after-line-breaking + cnb:chain-after-line-breaking!, reading via ly:grob-property-data to avoid premature callback evaluation). Confirmed en route that test-ids.ly never hooked NoteHead after-line-breaking (it tags at acknowledger time), so the NoteHead collision was latent rather than active; chaining closes it in both directions. Added 5 unit assertions for the pure composer and two integration regression tests (vector model and procedure model) proving the off-key mark and test-id tag coexist on the same F#4 NoteHead and that the Beam/Tie/Slur chained hooks fire. Suites green: unit 179/0 (baseline 174/0), integration 83/0 (baseline 72/0). Set-003's uncommitted attribution edits left untouched in the working tree.
